provenance_quote: such strains translocate the bacterial protein CagA into gastric epithelial cells by a type IV secretion system, encoded by the cag pathogenicity island.
notes: UniProt P55980 = CagA, Helicobacter pylori 26695 (matches gene+organism). DOI 10.1126/science.287.5457.1497 = Odenbreit 2000 Science (PMID 10688800); citation_quote verbatim in abstract. CagA is the canonical cag-PAI T4SS substrate.

provenance_quote: a large group of effectors (Lpg0103/VipF, Leg0208/LegK4, Lpg0437/Ceg14, Lpg1368/Lgt1, Lpg1488/Lgt3, Lpg2504/SidI, and Lpg2862/Lgt2) shown to manipulate eukaryotic protein translation
notes: uniprot blank (na). DOI 10.1038/s44320-024-00076-z = Patel 2024 Mol Syst Biol (PMID 39562741, PMC11696984); citation_quote verbatim in full text. Lpg0437/Ceg14 is a Legionella pneumophila Dot/Icm (T4BSS) effector; ss_type generic T4SS acceptable.

provenance_quote: The effector proteins (CBU0021, CBU0937, CBU1823, CBU1825 and CBU2013) were mainly associated with autophagy.
notes: UniProt Q83D09 = ordered locus CBU_0937, Coxiella burnetii RSA493 (matches locus+organism). DOI 10.1371/journal.ppat.1010660 = Fu 2022 PLoS Pathog (PMID 35816513, PMC9273094); citation_quote verbatim. Paper treats CBU0937 as a C. burnetii Dot/Icm T4SS effector in its 53-effector PPI map. Gene name CirD not explicitly named in this ref but locus/identity consistent.

provenance_quote: the VirB/D4 system is also involved in the translocation of several effector proteins, including VirE2, VirE3 and VirF into the host cell cytoplasm.
notes: UniProt P08061 = virE3, Agrobacterium fabrum/tumefaciens C58 (matches). DOI 10.1371/journal.ppat.1003948 = Padavannil 2014 PLoS Pathog (PMID 24626239, PMC3953389); citation_quote verbatim in abstract. VirE3 is a recognized VirB/D4 T4SS effector.

provenance_quote: These translocated effector proteins (Beps) A-G are encoded together with the VirB system and the T4S coupling protein VirD4 on a Bartonella-specific pathogenicity island.
notes: UniProt Q6G2A9 = bepA (Fido adenylyltransferase), Bartonella henselae Houston-1; UniProt itself annotates it as a T4SS effector translocated via VirB/VirD4. DOI 10.1073/pnas.0406796102 = Schulein 2005 PNAS; citation_quote supported. UniProt locus BH13370 vs ledger AYT27_RS06820 (RefSeq tag), consistent reannotation.

provenance_quote: translocation of BtpA-CyaA and CyaA-BtpB was clearly reduced in a virB genetic background, indicating that delivery of both proteins is dependent on the T4SS.
notes: BtpB is a real secreted VirB T4SS effector (Salcedo 2013 Front Cell Infect Microbiol, DOI 10.3389/fcimb.2013.00028, PMID 23847770, PMC3703528; quote verbatim). BUT ledger uniprot Q2YNA0 is WRONG: Q2YNA0 = DUF2069 protein BAB1_0782 (unrelated). Paper defines BtpB = BAB1_0756; correct accession is Q2YN91 (TIR domain protein, BAB1_0756, B. abortus 2308). Ledger locus BAB_RS19660 not independently re-mapped to BAB1_0756.

provenance_quote: This analysis resulted in the identification of the proteins encoded by BAB1_1652 (VceA) and BR1038/BAB1_1058 (VceC) as novel protein substrates of the Brucella T4SS.
notes: uniprot blank (na). VceC is a genuine Brucella VirB T4SS substrate (De Jong 2008 Mol Microbiol, DOI 10.1111/j.1365-2958.2008.06487.x; quote supported). VceC = BAB1_1058, which UniProt (Q2YQ34) maps to NC_007618.1 (chromosome I). Ledger genome NC_007624.1 is chromosome II = wrong genome accession; should be NC_007618.1. Ledger locus BAB_RS26945 not confirmed against BAB1_1058.

provenance_quote: we screened a genomic DNA library of A. phagocytophilum for effectors of the type IV secretion system by a bacterial two-hybrid system, using A. phagocytophilum VirD4 as bait. A hypothetical protein was identified as a putative effector, hereby named Anaplasma translocated substrate 1 (Ats-1).
notes: UniProt Q2GJL5 = ats-1, ordered locus APH_0859, Anaplasma phagocytophilum HZ (matches; ledger APH_RS03430 = RefSeq tag). DOI 10.1371/journal.ppat.1000774 = Niu 2010 PLoS Pathog (PMID 20174550, PMC2824752); quote verbatim in abstract. Ats-1 is a VirD4/T4SS effector.
